revisionDesc.change: Finalized - done
Vote - AcceptText - The new readings in lines 3 and 6 seem to be correct according to the printed image of the text.

Vote - AcceptText - Agreed. ἥδιον in lin6 implies reading ἢ ἱκ̣α̣[ in lin7, but it would have been useful to have a new interpretation of the passage based on the revised reading. It's an important text that has been cited extensively.
Submit - Corrections in lines 3 and 6.
Commit - Line 6 ends in ποιῶ.

Commit - Minor corrections: In line 3 τῇ => τῆι̣ (dotted) before π[ό]λει with a vertical, thick stroke (however, cf. τῇ ἀγορᾷ in line 8). In line 6 ἡδῖαν (l. ἡδεῖαν) => ἥδιον. The omicron here resembles other "open" omicrons in the text, such as the one in ου of νε[ω]τ̣[έ]ρου in line 7.
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - I would invert the order of the correction in lin2. Also add BL 7 to lin8
Submit - Added l. 1, which was missing, and 2 corrections from BL IX, though I'm wondering whether the 1st one should not be rather left in the apparatus.
Commit - Added BL IX, though I'm not sure I like Oliver's suggestion in l. 1 (space looks too short, and abbreviation unexpected).
Commit - Added 1st line, which had mysteriously disappeared, based on the edition.
